جُؤْشُوشٌ The breast, or chest; (S, A, K;) as also ↓ جَأْشٌ and ↓ جُؤْشٌ : (A:) or its حَيْزُوم, q. v. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) ―
-b2- The forepart (صَدْر) of the night; accord. to which explanation it is tropical: or what is between the beginning and the third thereof: or a while thereof: (TA:) or a portion thereof; (Lh, K;) and of people. (K.) ＝
-A2- Also A thick, or gross, or coarse, man. (Ibn- 'Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
